content: Use Seedance 2.5 to generate the first ~3 seconds (the hook) of an ad with a strong visual pattern interrupt (“wtf did I just see” moment).
tips: Use Seedance 2.5 to generate the first ~3 seconds (the hook) of an ad with a strong visual pattern interrupt (“wtf did I just see” moment).

es.content: Usa Seedance 2.5 para generar los primeros ~3 segundos (el gancho) de un anuncio con una fuerte interrupción visual del patrón (“¿qué acabo de ver?”).

fr.content: Utilisez Seedance 2.5 pour générer les ~3 premières secondes (le hook) d’une publicité avec une forte rupture de pattern visuel (un moment « mais qu’est-ce que je viens de voir ? »).

ja.content: Seedance 2.5 を使って、広告の最初の約3秒（フック）を生成し、強いビジュアルのパターン・インタラプト（「今、何を見たんだ？」と思わせる瞬間）を作り出す。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5를 사용해 광고의 첫 약 3초(훅)를 생성하세요. 강렬한 시각적 패턴 인터럽트로 “방금 내가 뭘 본 거지?”라는 순간을 만들어야 합니다.

pt.content: Use o Seedance 2.5 para gerar os primeiros ~3 segundos (o gancho) de um anúncio com uma forte interrupção visual de padrão (“que diabos eu acabei de ver?”).

zh.content: 使用 Seedance 2.5 生成广告开头约 3 秒（hook），营造强烈的视觉模式打断（“我刚刚看到了什么”那种瞬间）。
